official_parameters: 2.3 billion effective; 5.1 billion including per-layer embeddings
channel_scope: Text decoder gated-MLP intermediate channels only; not a count of every type of neuron in the model
actual_experiment_precision: Mixed NF4 4-bit weight storage/BF16 quantized-linear compute, BF16 unquantized large matrices, FP32 normalization vectors; past trained LoRA factors FP32. New pilot edits/branches will have explicit dtype records.
advertised_capabilities: Text output; text/image/audio inputs, video-frame understanding; coding, reasoning/thinking modes, native function calling and system prompts, multilingual use. E2B advertised context 128K.
measured_scope: Our prior experiments use text only, short fixed prompts, greedy generation and thinking disabled. No independent validation of full advertised context, modalities, tool use or official benchmark numbers.
inference: Affordable, hook-accessible model for a bounded quantized-E2B mechanistic study. Quantization is a scientific scope limitation; it cannot be assumed that an observed effect transfers to unquantized weights.
